# v0.6.0 plan — UDAP authorization code flows and explicit SMART backend scopes

Milestone: [v0.6.0](https://github.com/vanessuniq/safire/milestone/2) ·
Issues: #341 (explicit SMART backend scopes), #342 (UDAP authorization code +
refresh), #343 (release prep) · Depends on: v0.5.0 stack (D-05)

## Scope

- **Breaking:** SMART Backend Services without configured or per-call scopes
  raise `ConfigurationError` (D-16). Basis: SMART 2.2.0 backend-services.md
  token request `scope` required [N]; v0.4.1 deprecation notice.
- UDAP authorization code flow for consumer-facing and B2B apps (D-12):
  `authorization_url`, `request_access_token`, `refresh_token` on
  `protocol: :udap`.

## Dependency graph

```
release-0.5.0 (v0.5.0 tip) ─┬─ 6.1 feature/smart-backend-explicit-scopes ───────────────┐
                            └─ 6.2 feature/udap-authorization-url ── 6.3 feature/udap-authorization-code-token ── 6.4 feature/udap-refresh-token ─┤
                                                                                                                          ▼
                              6.5 integration/v0.6.0 (merge-only) ── 6.6 feature/demo-udap-authorization-code ── 6.7 docs/v0.6.0-release-notes ── [audit fixes] ── 6.R release-0.6.0
```

6.2–6.4 all edit `lib/safire/protocols/udap.rb`, so they are sequenced (file
ownership); 6.1 edits only SMART files and runs in parallel.

## Tasks and acceptance criteria

| # | Concern | Acceptance (spec basis) |
|---|---|---|
| 6.1 | SMART scope fallback removal | No `system/*.rs` default; `ConfigurationError` for nil/empty/blank-only scopes; explicit `user/`/`patient/` scopes still allowed (SMART backend-services §Scopes) |
| 6.2 | UDAP authorization request | `response_type=code`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `scope` (required), `state` (required, generated), `code_challenge` + `code_challenge_method=S256` [N general §7.2, §7.2.1, §7.2.2]; endpoint = signed `authorization_endpoint`, required when `authorization_code` advertised [N discovery §2.2–2.3]; wildcard rule (D-13, warning-only) |
| 6.3 | Code exchange | `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `redirect_uri` identical to authorization request, `code_verifier` [N consumer §4.2], AnT without `extensions`, `udap=1`, no `Authorization` header [N consumer §4.2.2] |
| 6.4 | Refresh | RFC 6749 §6 refresh with AnT "in the same manner as for initial token requests" [N b2b §5.3]; not for client_credentials |
| 6.6 | Demo | Authorization code launch + callback (state check) + refresh for UDAP |
| 6.7 | Release notes | CHANGELOG/ROADMAP/README/migration (SMART scopes) |

## Not verifiable locally

Real UDAP authorization servers (consent UI, Tiered OAuth) — WebMock only.
